note: SPEC vectors, not parity vectors. These record behaviour the articles specify and the reference Python engine does not have (it implements only `refuse`). Authored from the article, not generated. See conformance/README.md.

cases.name: satisfied_constraint_admits
cases.why: The ordinary path: nothing to decide.

cases.name: refuse_names_the_rule
cases.why: §VII: naming which law refused is the difference between an explanation and a shrug.

cases.name: clamp_projects_onto_the_edge
cases.why: Π_A on one axis. Capping at the available balance IS the exact projection, because the per-dimension box of V is convex.

cases.name: clamp_reports_what_was_asked_for_as_well_as_what_was_done
cases.why: §VII.3: a clamp commits something nobody asked for, and must be reported as such every time. The verdict is not representable without both values.

cases.name: clamp_on_a_non_interval_is_rejected_at_authoring_time
cases.why: §VII.1: V is not convex in general. On a non-convex A the minimiser may be non-unique, and 'project' stops being well-defined.

cases.name: clamp_on_an_equality_is_rejected_at_authoring_time
cases.why: Equality pins a point rather than bounding an interval; projecting onto it would overwrite rather than cap.

cases.name: clamp_on_a_conserved_dimension_is_rejected_at_authoring_time
cases.why: §VII.2: capping a transfer's outflow while leaving the inflow untouched CREATES MONEY — it satisfies C by violating D.

cases.name: an_exclusive_bound_refuses_rather_than_inventing_an_epsilon
cases.why: A strict inequality has no nearest admissible point. Refusing is honest; picking an arbitrary epsilon is not.

cases.name: defer_is_a_third_verdict
cases.why: §VII: the gate's codomain is not boolean. Sheridan & Verplank level 5 — executed only if the human approves.

cases.name: a_deferral_always_requires_readmission_at_commit
cases.why: Deferral makes a synchronous transition pending, so the state at approval need not be the state at proposal. Admitting once at proposal loses complete mediation.

cases.name: refuse_is_the_default_when_no_strategy_is_declared
cases.why: The safe choice when nothing more specific has been established.

cases.name: an_unparseable_declaration_is_rejected_not_skipped
cases.why: A rule that cannot be read must never be silently dropped from enforcement — that is a gate failing open.
